_source: L14: the one source of truth for chat commands. ChatCmd answers !help / !commands and !help <cmd> from it; tools/_commands_doc.gd writes docs/COMMANDS.md from it (the hub / website reads the same file). Costs are the list price before the haggle (a CHA check at the counter) and the guild-rank discount.

enlist.short: Raise your hero: a calling and a people, either order. Leave either out and the valley picks.
enlist.what: Raise your hero. Callings: knight, warden, barbarian, rogue, duelist, ranger, mage, sage, cleric, paladin, necromancer, monk, druid, warlock, bard. Peoples: human, elf, dwarf, halfling, orc, scarkin. Either order; leave either out and the valley picks.

hero.what: Your hero's sheet: people and calling, rank, level, AC, HP, to-hit, abilities, saves, weapon and its dice, armour, potions, oil, gold, record.

catchup.short: What your hero did while you were away, in a line.
catchup.what: What happened to your hero while you were away: what they did, how it went, and where they stand now. One line, kept short on purpose - the Chronicle of every day in full, and the sheet behind it, are on the hub.

inventory.what: What your hero carries: title, weapon, armour, accessories, dye, brews, oil, gold, and the best fish caught.

weapon.short: The named steel you carry and its rarity step.
weapon.what: The weapon your hero carries by name, its step on the rarity ladder, the tier it was forged at, and its damage dice. The smithy forges the next tier - !forge.

armour.short: The mail you wear, its rarity step, and your AC.
armour.what: The armour your hero wears by name, its step on the rarity ladder, the tier it was made at, and the armour class it leaves you. The armoury sells the next tier - !armoury.

delve.what: Walk to the scar and go down with the next party. Everyone brings their own oil and it is pooled at the mouth; out of oil, the dark wins.

muster.short: Who is waiting at the dungeon mouth, and where you stand.
muster.what: Who is waiting at the dungeon mouth, in the order their names went in, and where you stand in the line. The muster takes six from chat. A hero sent down by a channel-point errand is counted too, however they were sent.

fish.what: Walk to a dock and fish: junk to rare catches.

forge.short: Next weapon tier at the smithy, in a kind of your calling (!forge list).
forge.cost: 60 / 160 / 420 / 1100 gold by tier (rework at the top: a quarter)
forge.what: Buy the next weapon tier at the smithy, in your calling's kinds: sword, greatsword, dagger, spear / axe, mace, greataxe / staff, sceptre, wand / crossbow, bow / quarterstaff, wraps. !forge list shows yours and the next price. The best tiers need Bellmire to grow; scarforged steel is only found below. The smithy carries a level and the level is the ceiling: level 1 stocks common, level 4 stocks very rare, and no counter in Bellmire stocks higher.

armoury.short: Next armour tier: leather, chainmail, plate, warded plate.
armoury.what: Buy the next armour tier: leather, chainmail, plate, warded plate. It shows: boots, pauldrons, a helm. Scarwoven mail is only found below. The smithy carries a level and the level is the ceiling: level 1 stocks common, level 4 stocks very rare, and no counter in Bellmire stocks higher.

brew.short: Brews at the apothecary; no name buys Mending.
brew.what: Buy brews at the apothecary. No name buys Draughts of Mending. Names: mending, greater, superior, supreme, antidote, emberward, hearthwarm, quickwater (haste), ogre (strength), shadow (unseen), bravecup (heroism), owl (darkvision). Heroes drink them below when they need to.

oil.what: Buy lamp oil: one flask lights a floor for two delvers. A floor costs a flask at least, however few go down.

wear.short: Buy and wear an accessory or a cosmetic (a hat, a banner, a pet, a title).
wear.what: Buy and wear an accessory (rings, amulets, cloaks, boots, gloves - small bonuses) or a cosmetic (hats, banners, a pet, a title). Owned things are worn again for nothing. !wear off ring takes one off.

dye.what: Dye your armour and cloak: black, white, red, blue, green, gold, purple, teal, brown, grey.

reroll.short: Dead: a new hero. Alive: throw your scores again.
reroll.what: Dead: raise a new hero. Alive: throw your ability scores again (a worse throw keeps the old ones).

respec.what: Take up another calling, keeping your hero.

guild.what: The Guild Roll: who stands highest.

patrons.what: Those who have kept the valley going.

look.short: A 10 s spotlight pane on your hero, when the channel-points lane is free.
look.what: Ask for a look at your hero: a 10-second pane in the channel-points lane (teal), only when nobody has redeemed it or is waiting. Cheers, subs and redeems get their own longer panes.

hub.short: Bellmire's own page: your full sheet, the Chronicle, the Satchel, the Bestiary.
hub.what: Bellmire's own page. Your hero's full sheet, the Chronicle of every day, the Satchel and what the counter pays, crests, the Hall of the Fallen, the Bestiary and the Night Watch. Search it by name.

satchel.short: What the counter would pay for what you carry: two fifths of shop cost.
satchel.what: What the counter would pay for what your hero carries. Anything you own and are not wearing is priced at two fifths of its shop cost, per item. Your own Satchel, priced row by row, is on the hub.

caravan.short: A trade caravan comes up the west road, trades at the market, and goes.
caravan.what: A caravan master walks in from the west road with a wagon, stands at the market a while, then settles the trade against Bellmire's own prices: it sells the town the goods the town is short of and buys up whatever the town has too much of. Then it takes the road back out. A festival brings one in sooner. Twenty-eight carts are written, each with a name, a road it came from and a load, and how far the town has grown decides which of them can turn up. Asking changes nothing - it only reports. The caravan's arrival and what it traded go into the Chronicle on the hub.

festival.short: A festival gathers the town in the market square.
festival.what: A festival gathers Bellmire in the market square - music, stalls, a crowd, and a caravan is likelier while it runs. The town growing a level calls one. A festival a viewer paid for is theirs: the square is strung with gold in their name.

town.short: What Bellmire is: its tier, its souls, its treasury, what stands.
town.what: Bellmire's own standing: the tier it has grown into and that tier's number, the day, how many souls live there, what is in the treasury, how many houses are up and which of the market hall, stables, guild hall, bathhouse and mage tower are open, and the score the next tier needs. Asking changes nothing - it only reports. The town's day-by-day Chronicle is on the hub.

bestiary.short: What haunts the dark, depth by depth, and the eight lords.
bestiary.what: What haunts the dark, depth by depth: each beast's real size, its habits in a fight, where it is at home, and the eight lords that hold the deep. The whole Bestiary is on the hub.

miniboss.short: The 63 elites that hold a chamber alone, each by name.
miniboss.what: The 63 elites that hold a chamber alone, one to a chamber. Ask with no name for how many stand and how to ask; ask by name, or by the trade it keeps as its mark, for one of them: what it is called, what it was, and how it looks when you come through the door. Asking changes nothing - it only reports. Every line of their feed is on the hub.

help.what: The command list; !help <command> for one in detail.

ask._why: L69: a viewer who does not know the commands still gets an answer. A line with NO leading ! is flattened to words and matched against these phrases; the first topic in `order` that matches answers. A topic with `reply` is a shared answer and is said to the channel at most once every `gap_s` seconds, so twelve people asking the same thing in a burst get one answer instead of twelve. A topic with `cmd` runs that command for the asker instead - their own sheet differs per viewer, so those are never held back. A pattern with + wants every one of those words present; any other pattern is the phrase itself, matched on a word boundary. A new answer is an edit here, not in code.

join.reply: Anyone can play. Type !enlist and you have a hero in Bellmire - name a calling and a people if you want them, or the valley picks. Then !oil, then !delve.

real.reply: Real game. Bellmire is built in Godot and runs on this machine while the stream is up. Every hero, every delve and every death is written down.

what.reply: Bellmire is a town with a hole under it. Viewers each get a hero, send them down for gold and gear, and the town grows or buries them. !enlist to get one.

gear.reply: Gold buys it in town: !forge for a weapon, !armoury for armour, !wear for rings, cloaks and the like. The best steel is only found below.

gold.reply: Two ways: !delve and bring something back, or !fish at the docks. The counter also pays two fifths of shop cost for anything you own and are not wearing - !satchel.

bits.reply: Cheering lights a pane on your hero for the channel to watch - the bigger the cheer, the longer it holds. Subs and point redeems get their own pane.

bug.reply: If you found a bug, head to the guild hall and use the Suggestion Box - !hub to get there. The builders read every one.

suggest.reply: Got an idea for Bellmire? The guild hall has a Suggestion Box - !hub and look for it. Every suggestion gets read.

afk.reply: The game runs itself while the streamer is away - your hero keeps living, fighting and trading. !hero to check on yours.

died.reply: Heroes fall, but the valley always needs more. !enlist for a new one - pick a calling and a people, or let the valley choose.

howdelve.reply: !delve sends your hero into the scar - deeper floors pay more but hit harder. Oil your lamp first (!oil) or you go nowhere.

howbands.reply: A band is a party of heroes delving together. !muster joins the next one forming - bands share the danger and split what they find.

standing.reply: Standing is your place on the guild roll - earned by gold, kills and surviving. The deeper you go, the faster it climbs. !guild shows the ranks.

permadeath.reply: Death is real here. Your hero joins the Fallen and their name is remembered, but you keep nothing. !enlist gets a fresh start.

creator.reply: Built by JestSayin96 - the game, the bot, the guild hall, all of it. Come watch it grow.

howoil.reply: Oil lights your lamp for the scar. No lamp, no delve. !oil before you !delve - the town gives one free.

foreign._why: Other apps reading the same chat (Mr. E, Nov 11). Bellmire never answers these, and never nudges a word that is one of them, starts with one of their prefixes, or is a near miss of one - a viewer's !hug works in the overlay, and a 'No !hug here' in the Chronicle would read as a broken game. A new overlay command is an edit here, not in code. Never add a Bellmire command that matches one.
